package filters

// CourseFilters contains filter criteria for courses.
type CourseFilters struct {
	ID                *string
	Slug              *string
	Status            *int
	CatalogVisible    *bool
	Title             *string // from course_i18n
	TagID             *int
	TagSlug           *string
	CourseGroupID     *string
	LevelID           *string
	LevelSlug         *string
	TrackID           *string
	TrackSlug         *string
	CatalogActiveOnly bool
	CatalogOrdered    bool
	Page              *int
	Limit             *int
}
